title: When the Harvest Sings
premise: Lior Kavanagh returns to the family farm to bury her twin sister Senna, only to learn the body in the casket is not her sister — and that the excavation crew has uncovered a door beneath the orchard, sealed from the inside, humming with something alive. The founders of Kavanagh Hollow bound a hungry presence beneath their land with an annual ritual of substitution: one twin goes down so the other walks free. Lior discovers she was always meant to be the offering, that 'Senna' escaped ten years ago by sending Lior away in her place, and now the debt has come due. In the end, Lior descends willingly — but she speaks the ritual's closing words backward, unbinding the founders' covenant at the cost of her own name, leaving the hollow free and herself unremembered by everyone she saved.
about_author: A. M. Amberdale is the pen name of a former agricultural archivist who spent years cataloguing land deeds in rural county offices, where the gaps in inheritance records first suggested darker stories. They write horror about families who mistake property for legacy.

chapters.title: The Wrong Body
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Returning for Senna's funeral, Lior lifts the coffin lid against her aunt's warnings and finds a stranger's face — one that has been dead far longer than a week. That night, scratching sounds rise from beneath the floorboards, rhythmic and patient. Emotional beat: dread braided with guilt, as Lior realizes the noises she dismissed for ten years have followed her home.

chapters.title: Sealed from the Inside
chapters.summary: Alternating Lior's POV with entries from founder Elias Kavanagh's 1847 ledger. The excavation crew breaches a stone door under the orchard; it was locked from within, and the foreman is found standing in the pit, smiling, reciting names. The ledger reveals the tithe: every generation, one twin descends. Emotional beat: horrified recognition — Lior understands why her parents sent her away, and what they were really protecting.

chapters.title: What Senna Left Behind
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. Following Senna's hidden notes, Lior learns her sister faked her death and fled, leaving Lior as the substitute the land would eventually claim. The thing beneath the door begins wearing Senna's voice, then her mother's, begging to be let out. Villagers who know the truth close ranks around her. Emotional beat: betrayal curdling into fury — Lior decides she will not be anyone's sacrifice, not even her sister's.

chapters.title: The Closing Word
chapters.summary: Lior's POV. At the autumn equinox, with the door splitting open and the town's children sleepwalking toward the pit, Lior descends alone into the dark where the founders' chorus still sings. She completes the ritual — then reverses its final word, severing the covenant and the presence together. She emerges nameless; no one remembers her. Emotional beat: grim transcendence — survival achieved by erasure, the harvest finally silent.
